config._note: CONFIG/TECHNICAL archetype — an SMS reminder channel is provider configuration (template, timing, sender ID, retry policy, GDPR opt-out). It configures messaging but is not itself a conversation, so NO email/talk/calendar widget (the record declares no comms linkedType). Native shillinq detail contract: the config renders from config.fields[] (including the calculated renderedPreview / character-count / fallback-valid fields), lifecycleActions activate/deactivate the channel, and the immutable audit trail lives in the sidebar so an admin can see who changed the template or timing. NO files/aggregation — a channel config has no attachments and no financial totals.

fields.label: Preview (sample data)
fields.help: Template rendered with example booking variables.

fields.label: Preview length
fields.help: Character count of the rendered preview; a real send must stay within 160 characters.

fields.label: Send before (minutes)
fields.help: Minutes before the booking start to dispatch the reminder (1440 = 24h).

fields.label: Fallback phone number
fields.help: Used when the booking contact has no number. NL/E.164 format (+31… or 06…).

fields.label: Sender ID
fields.help: Shown to the recipient. Max 11 characters.

fields.label: Respect opt-out
fields.help: When on, recipients who opted out of SMS reminders are skipped (GDPR). Leave on unless this is a transactional-only channel.
